NOEMA Atlas for Windows x64 — bundled software

NOEMA Atlas's application code, Copyright (c) 2026 Patrick Karlsson, uses the MIT license in NOEMA-Atlas-LICENSE.txt. NOEMA is the project and product name.
The program also distributes components under their own terms.

Electron's license and Chromium notices accompany the Windows executable.
JavaScript dependency and font licenses are in resources/app.asar. The
museum collection has separate credits, source object links and its CC0
statement in resources/reference.

ONNX Runtime 1.31.1: LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices from the upstream
Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 1.31.1 NuGet package.
https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime/1.31.1

DirectML 1.15.4: license terms and notices from Microsoft.AI.DirectML 1.15.4.
https://www.nuget.org/packages/Microsoft.AI.DirectML/1.15.4
DirectX Shader Compiler notices correspond to revision b4711839e.
https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/tree/b4711839e

sharp 0.35.5 uses the Windows libvips 8.18.7 shared libraries. Their
component versions and notices accompany this file. The upstream source,
Windows build scripts and pinned dependency versions are available here:
https://github.com/lovell/sharp/tree/v0.35.5
https://github.com/libvips/libvips/tree/v8.18.7
https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/tree/v1.3.4
https://github.com/lovell/sharp-libvips/blob/v1.3.4/versions.properties

The Windows distribution uses separate, dynamically loaded native DLLs
in resources/app.asar.unpacked. The GNU GPL and LGPL texts accompany
the library notices. The licenses of these components govern their use.
